integrity: Proof by exact strong-gradient inequality constraints and van Kampen; finite reference program independently reconstructs gradients and mod-two first homology for cycles of lengths 4 through 8.
scientific_limitations: Only the fundamental group and the two-skeleton are classified. The higher homotopy type remains undetermined here, regardless of homology formulas established elsewhere. Finite permutation checks independently corroborate, but do not replace, the all-length proof. Earlier bibliographic equivalents outside the inspected literature cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp simple-connectivity threshold for strong Morse matching complexes of cycles
